core_obligations: Rigid random inclusions couple incompressibility, pressure and force/torque balance, so scalar elliptic homogenization estimates do not apply directly. The authors combine stochastic corrector cancellations, annealed regularity, sensitivity/buckling and constrained two-scale boundary error estimates to control both velocity and pressure with the printed stochastic moment rates.
